title: Motion (Harris-Dawson - Yaroslavsky) relative to the City Administrative Officer and Chief Legislative Analyst, in coordination with the Los Angeles World…
text:
[Council File 15-0989-S72]
Motion (Harris-Dawson - Yaroslavsky) relative to the City Administrative Officer and Chief Legislative Analyst, in coordination with the Los Angeles World Airports, Los Angeles Metro, and the Los Angeles Homeless Services Authority, to report on a plan addressing homeless encampment resolution and unhoused outreach and housing placement during the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games.
(Referred to Homelessness and Health Committee and Ad Hoc Committee on the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games)
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion asking the city administrative office and legislative analyst to report on a plan for encampment resolution and unhoused outreach and housing placement during the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games.

outcome.text: Homelessness and Health Committee approved as amended (Oct 14, 2026)
